goal.insight: Render a parallel coordinates chart with 8 vertical axes (one per benchmark dimension), where each polyline represents a model, colored by model family (e.g., GPT=blue, Claude=purple, Gemini=green, LLaMA=orange, Qwen=red), with a legend mapping families to colors
Visually emphasize the crossing pattern between the Reasoning axis and the Inference Speed axis, showing that models scoring high on reasoning tend to dip on speed and vice versa
Highlight the divergent line trajectories between the Multimodal Understanding axis and the Math/Quantitative axis, drawing attention to models that excel in one but drop in the other
Show how polylines of the same model family color tend to cluster together across most axes, revealing family-level capability profiles
Make the top-performing models visually prominent (e.g., thicker or brighter lines) so viewers can quickly identify which models dominate across multiple dimensions
